title: RAE Progress Event Payload
description: Minimal structured live progress event emitted by RAE during execution so Team IW can show stage-level progress in Jira. Events are written only to the mounted JSONL side-channel specified by runtime_request.output_paths.progress_events_path. This schema does not include final metrics, artifacts, diagnostics, or HDFS paths; those belong to the final runtime response contract. The event shape is a live subset of the final response iteration_traces vocabulary.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this RAE container run. Should match runtime_request.run_id.

ticket_id.description: Jira ticket key, for example SCRUM-46.

stage.description: Independent execution stage. Stages do not require previous or subsequent stages to fire.

status.description: Stage-level live progress status. SUCCESS, FAILED and SKIPPED align with final response iteration_traces. PENDING and RUNNING are live-only progress states.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in RFC3339 / ISO-8601 format.

iteration.description: Optional Swarm/agent iteration number, matching final response iteration_traces where available.

agent.description: Optional agent name, matching final response iteration_traces where available.

tool_call.description: Optional tool call name, matching final response iteration_traces where available.

message.description: Optional short human-readable message. Keep minimal to avoid log noise.
